service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , USE_NUMBER , SUBJECT , CASE WHEN (CORP_FLAG = 'Y') THEN 'S01' ELSE 'S02' END AS APP_TYPE , CASE WHEN (CORP_FLAG = 'Y') THEN '법인인감' ELSE '사용인감/영문서명인' END AS APP_TYPE_LOC FROM SUDGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ

SELECT GWAD.HOUSE_CODE , GWAD.COMPANY_CODE , GWAD.LINE_TYPE , GWAD.APP_TYPE , GWAD.CODE , GWAD.LINE_SEQ , GWAD.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , GWAD.APP_METHOD , CASE WHEN(#DB_OWNER#NVL(GWAD.ADD_DATE, '')='') THEN '' ELSE (CONCAT(SUBSTR(GWAD.ADD_DATE,1,4) , '/' , SUBSTR(GWAD.ADD_DATE,5,2) , '/' , SUBSTR(GWAD.ADD_DATE, 7, 2),' ',SUBSTR(GWAD.ADD_TIME,1,2) , ':' , SUBSTR(GWAD.ADD_TIME,3,2) , ':' , SUBSTR(GWAD.ADD_TIME, 5, 2))) END AS ADD_DATETIME , USMT_A.USER_NAME_LOC AS ADD_USER_NAME_LOC , DEPT_A.DEPT_NAME_LOC AS ADD_DEPT_NAME_LOC FROM SGWAD GWAD LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = GWAD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = GWAD.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = GWAD.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = GWAD.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT_A ON USMT_A.HOUSE_CODE = GWAD.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT_A.USER_ID = GWAD.ADD_USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT DEPT_A ON DEPT_A.HOUSE_CODE = GWAD.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT_A.COMPANY_CODE = GWAD.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT_A.DEPT = USMT_A.DEPT WHERE GWAD.HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND GWAD.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND LINE_TYPE = ${LINE_TYPE} AND APP_TYPE = ${APP_TYPE} AND CODE = ${CODE} ORDER BY CAST(GWAD.LINE_SEQ AS INT) DESC
